name: dmp-loyalty
description: Hệ thống quản lý đại lý & tích điểm DMP Việt Pháp — MVP

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dmp/shared && npm run build -w @dmp/api && npm run build -w @dmp/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @dmp/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @dmp/api" "npm run dev -w @dmp/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @dmp/shared && npm run test -w @dmp/api
